A) **Sweep drama: 7/10.** The background delivers a strong diagonal gradient from a hot, near-white glow in the top-left to a deep, crushed black in the bottom-right, creating a convincing sense of a single dramatic key light.

B) **Card frosted with lit edge + cast shadow: Yes.** The sign-in card features a translucent, frosted glass effect (glassmorphism) that blurs the background behind it. It has a distinct bright highlight along its top and left edges, suggesting it is catching the key light, and it sits atop a soft, dark cast shadow that gives it physical depth and separation from the background.

C) **Pass.** The visual hierarchy is clear, all text is highly readable against the dark and frosted elements, and the overall aesthetic successfully matches the requested "dramatic raytraced" brief.
